# Europe Journal, 1966

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
source("R/proofread.R")
source("R/book_helpers.R")
final <- apply_corrections()
vol <- "vol2"
```

Source file: `vol2.pdf`. This is a separate document from the WWII journals and is processed in its own run. Pages 1 to 6 are front matter (a three-page table of contents, an itinerary and a mail schedule); entries begin on page 7 with the entry for Friday, 24 June 1966. The text includes German, French and Dutch names.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-status
#| tbl-cap: "Review status of this document."
volume_status(final) |> filter(volume == vol) |> kable()
```

The text below is published only after review. Until then the chunk is switched off. To publish, change `eval: false` to `eval: true` in the chunk and render. Pages that still show `ocr_draft` in the status table are unreviewed OCR, and `[?word]` marks flag words that were not resolved.

```{r}
#| label: transcription
#| eval: false
#| results: asis
cat(volume_markdown(final, vol))
```
